photos.title_or_caption: Mitsawokett: A 17th Century Native American Community in Central Delaware
photos.subject_names: L. Carney, Abd al-Hakeem Carney, L Carney, native of Providence, Rhode Island, known as Shaykh 'Abd, died on July, at the, College of Bard, University of London, studied the Arabic langu, and completed, the levels of muqaddimah, the Organisation, the Journal of, of 'Mantiq al-Muzhafr', and poetry., Studies in London, Religious Studies at Lawrence University, in Appleton, when he died., as Shaykh 'Abd al-Hakeem, including the Imam Khu'i, Lecturer at Rhode Island, Professor at Providence, of Fallston, and Dorothy Carney of Elmer, of Wisdom in Dearborn Heights, in London, and at Wayne State in, Ancestry of father, Larry S. Carney, HOH = Hansley or Handsor, | D | E-L |, M | N-R | S-Z, Native American Communities of, and Southern New Jersey"
